description: This file defines an abstract class 'BearerTokenIdentity' in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing the use of Bearer Token credentials. It implements the 'IdentityInterface' and declares an abstract method 'getExpiration'.

classes.name: BearerTokenIdentity
classes.description: An abstract class representing Bearer Token credentials in AWS SDK for PHP, providing a method to get token expiration.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Returns a UNIX timestamp indicating token expiration, or null if not set.
